exposure: Four groups based on epidural analgesia regimen
outcome: Pain scores (NRS) at rest, during movement, and during uterine massage
finding: Epidural administration of 0.15% ropivacaine combined with 0.5 mcg/ml sufentanil provided optimal pain relief after cesarean section, resulting in lower pain scores, faster recovery of bowel function, and higher patient satisfaction, despite a higher incidence of pruritus and numbness.
